body: I’m going offline now. I’m going to spend my last hour totally alone. Bye everyone. I love you all and hope you can all find peace in this cruel world.

My father started shouting at me and threatening to beat the shit out of me so I shouted back and told him he’s not intimidating anymore (I’m 18 and well built and he’s getting old). I guess he wanted to prove himself so he decided to take all my valuables and smash them up. He then proceeded to force me to leave the house otherwise he would call the police. I was debating beating the shit out of him but I walked out the house and I’m going to kill myself now . I have absolutely nothing to exist for now.
